output.question: What is Oracle's annual revenue?
output.answer: Oracle's latest full-year revenue is $67.4 billion for fiscal 2026, which ended May 31, 2026. That is up 17% in US dollars from the prior year. Cloud revenue made up about half of it, rising 39% to $34.0 billion. Fourth-quarter revenue was a record $19.2 billion, up 21%. For fiscal 2027, Oracle kept its earlier guidance of about $90 billion in total revenue.

key_facts.fact: FY2026 total revenue (year ended May 31, 2026) was $67.4 billion, up 17% in USD.
FY2026 cloud revenue rose 39% to $34.0 billion.
Q4 FY2026 total revenue rose 21% to $19.2 billion, a record.
Oracle kept its prior guidance of $90 billion in FY2027 total revenue.

passages.quote: For fiscal year 2026, Oracle reported total revenues of $67.4 billion, up 17% in US dollars.
For fiscal year 2026, Oracle said total revenue increased 17% to $67.4bn, with cloud revenue up 39% to $34.0bn.
The company said total revenue for the quarter rose 21% to $19.2bn.
For full-year fiscal 2027, Oracle confirmed prior guidance of $90bn in total revenue

caveats: Oracle's fiscal year ends May 31, so 'annual revenue' here means FY2026 (June 2025 to May 2026), not calendar 2026.

Oracle's own earnings release (oracle.com, June 10, 2026) blocked access (HTTP 403), and the SEC exhibit PDF could not be read as text. The figures come from two news outlets that agree with each other and with the release excerpt shown in search results.
Oracle has probably reported Q1 FY2027 results (quarter ended Aug 31, 2026) since then, which would change trailing-twelve-month revenue. I did not check that report.
